section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch28 — Sports, Awards, Books & Misc
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: The highest civilian award in India is the:
explanation: The Bharat Ratna is India's highest civilian honour. Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan and Padma Shri follow in descending order of precedence.

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch28 — Sports, Awards, Books & Misc
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: The highest sporting honour in India, recently renamed from the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna, is now called the:
explanation: The award was renamed the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna in 2021, honouring the hockey legend. The Arjuna Award recognises consistent excellence; the Dronacharya Award honours coaches.

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch28 — Sports, Awards, Books & Misc
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: The Jnanpith Award, India's highest literary honour, is given for outstanding contribution to:

options.option_text: Literature written in any Indian language listed in the Eighth Schedule

explanation: The Jnanpith Award honours a body of work in any of India's officially recognised (Eighth Schedule) languages — not restricted to a single language, and unrelated to science or film.

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch28 — Sports, Awards, Books & Misc
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: Neeraj Chopra won India's first-ever Olympic gold medal in athletics, in which event, at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics?
explanation: Neeraj Chopra won gold in the javelin throw at Tokyo 2020, India's first Olympic athletics gold and only the second individual gold in Indian Olympic history (after Abhinav Bindra in shooting).

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch28 — Sports, Awards, Books & Misc
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: The autobiography 'The Story of My Experiments with Truth' was written by:
explanation: Gandhi wrote this autobiography, originally serialised in Gujarati. Nehru's autobiography is 'Toward Freedom'; his 'The Discovery of India' is a separate, distinct work.
